theorems.name: Submission.chart_tangentialDivergence_eq_gram_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (y : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), Function.Injective A → tangentSpace M y = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → tangentialDivergence M Y y = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L fderiv ℝ Y y ∘L A).toLinearMap
